single_central_basis_band.vendor_expansion: One central TE profile at all 500 frequencies, as described by Ansys.
single_central_basis_band.native_method: Time projections interpolated once at the saved central-mode wavelength; same weights then applied at every frequency. The actual vendor and local profiles have their measured overlap at that frequency.

vendor_absolute_phase_basis: Matched fixed central ring profile and qualified samples
